product.name: DESIGN-LAB
product.positioning: Agent-platform-neutral professional visual intelligence and reusable design capability system: visual intelligence, aesthetic analysis, prompt intelligence, a design capability library, creative tool automation and knowledge candidates across professional visual domains; commercial visual quality and host-native editable delivery are capability outputs governed by evidence and human gates, with no default host; not a second canvas, editor or full-file delivery platform, and AAOS remains the formal knowledge authority.

neutralityPolicy.modelNeutral: no single model is baked in as the product capability; controlled Agent/media adapters
neutralityPolicy.styleNeutral: no Apple/black-gold/tech-blue/HUD/master style is a global default
neutralityPolicy.domainNeutral: public kernel serves brand, graphic, ui-ux, editorial, ecommerce, packaging, spatial, exhibition, 3D, motion, video, game visual
neutralityPolicy.platformNeutral: any design AGENT platform may act as host/entry; no default host, agent, or model is bound in the product contract
neutralityPolicy.versionNeutral: no host or tool version is pinned as a product requirement

requires: license or rights status with allowed usage

nonGoals: replace Open Design app, daemon, Studio/canvas, or model routing
build a second canvas, editor, or full-process design file delivery platform as the product body
become a general Agent Runtime, chat client, model gateway, or cross-project scheduler
take over WORK-LAB general workflow/governance or AAOS formal knowledge truth
treat popular resources or model output as qualified capability or trusted knowledge
upload client, private, or unlicensed third-party assets by default
build a second canvas, chat client, model gateway, or general SaaS backend
copy protected master signatures, branded assets, fonts, logos, images, or layouts
vendor unreviewed third-party repositories, model weights, fonts, installers, credentials, or private runtime state
claim runtime or commercial readiness from static files alone
make MiniGame operational/advertising/monetization the platform mainline
